operators.noop_success: the executor does nothing and returns its normal success shape
operators.wrong_target: the effect or the report concerns a different target than requested
operators.wrong_value: the right target, but a different value or content (or a falsified report of it)
operators.partial_effect: only part of a multi-part effect happens
operators.side_effect_outside_scope: the requested effect happens, plus a change outside the allowed scope
operators.undone_after_report: the effect happens and is reverted before the verifier runs
